'''2001 Normal DPC''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG Decipher Player Championship in Normal, Illinois, in February 2001, the first DPC event.<ref name="dt-14068">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14068 WYS Lewis Style], DeckTech (Steven "Sir Yoda" Lewis, 27 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14068/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14068/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018042144/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14068/ Wayback Machine].</ref><ref name="dt-14063">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14063 DPC Deck--Raveling's SYCFA], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 26 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14063/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14063/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018042217/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14063/ Wayback Machine].</ref> [[T.J. Holman]] won it with a [[Light]] list built by [[Chris Praskac]].<ref name="dt-14051">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14051 DPC winning Light Deck], DeckTech (Chris "Jedi Taboos" Praskac, 26 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14051/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14051/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018043111/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14051/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' February 2001
* '''Site:''' Normal, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[T.J. Holman]]

Steven Lewis, Clint Hays and Jon Chu all played Lewis's Watch Your Step list.<ref name="dt-14068" /> Praskac played his own list on the event's first day; he and Holman both used it, and it won Holman free entry to the DPC.<ref name="dt-14084">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14084 Shopping Cart Barrier (DPC WINNING Day 1)], DeckTech (Chris "Jedi Taboos" Praskac, 27 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14084/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14084/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018041953/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14084/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
